title: Replay the #7113 caller as normalized P104 word primitives
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The direct #7113 source-record and normalized #7852 primitive computations agree after all 4,783 records over q⁴=1 and i²=−1, with all 72 target rows and 1,768 native assignments bound. A first-J role mutation preserves packed pricing while changing 96 contacts and breaking three exact target rows. A separate reverse native scalar calculation checks 1,484 public rows. The generated Lean literals are included as uncompiled data.

## Task and overlap

Pinned #7113 07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d, #7829 1fdc9ecd1b1311d8ea6e02b6f81ae0d8d24999e2 and #7852 41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212. Extends #7864's packed correspondence and addresses the source-identity item in #7869 at 06c207a9feb3994a4b987dc3010657b6e85b7956 at the executable level.

## Validation and credit

python3 -B verify_packet.py passed in 36.77 s on a fresh offline copy. The packet manifest and the internal source pin both reject a changed caller. Offline replay verifies the public file hashes. Thanks to Rohan Arun, DreamingOfClouds and the retained source contributors. OpenAI Codex assisted this bridge and review.

## Open next questions

Compile the payload and prove the record-to-primitive interpretation, evaluator and CallerWord.Legal in Lean. Physical frame and phase geometry require separate proofs.
